headline: Greer Continues Talks on Trade and Control of Chinese Inputs with Mexico
summary: The US and Mexico remain in talks on trade and the control of manufacturing inputs from China, USTR chief Jamieson Greer said on Wednesday.
why: Trade rules on Chinese components affect North American manufacturing supply chains, and the USTR leads US trade negotiations.
original_headline: Greer continúa conversando sobre comercio y control de insumos chinos con México
